name: azure/playwright
title: Playwright Workspaces on Azure — hosted browsers

PLAYWRIGHT_SERVICE_URL.description: Your workspace's regional endpoint. An address, not a credential.

PLAYWRIGHT_SERVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Microsoft says an access token is like a password for the workspace and not to distribute, hard-code or store one in plain text. Only needed when not using Entra ID, which is the default. Every token expires on a date set at creation.
